title: nothing merges to main while a batch's CI is running, the owner included
why: Direct ask, Oct 28 13:36 CDT (shiv): a rule that no one, me included, merges to main while a batch's CI runs. Cause in the open: batch 13's lanes (c182 #777, c187 #778) each conflict with batch 12 (#779), and a merge to main under a running batch run moves the base the run is testing.
note: Next cloud lane, claude-settings only. Add a rule to the root CLAUDE.md Git section (an anchored sentence, beside git-integration-branch-merge and git-never-merge-failing-ci): while a batch's integration PR has a CI run in progress, nothing merges to main, by any session or by shiv. Record it as a decision (his ruling, Oct 28 13:36 CDT). Mechanize it: merge.py and the merge guard refuse to merge any PR while another PR's required-check run is in progress against the same base, and say which run and how to wait (the CI-done comment wakes the session). Red first: a fixture with one batch run in progress and a second PR ready; the merge refuses; with the run done it passes. The limit: a click on GitHub's own Merge button cannot be refused by a hook; the guard stops sessions and merge.py, and the rule binds shiv by his own word. Port: yes, the rule is global. Needs no answer. Placed after c190 (triage 12, Oct 28): it governs every batch. Lane session started Oct 28 (Opus, session_013NEJL3obk8uGUg5NhVk5vC). Built, Oct 28 19:28 CDT (coordinator): draft #795, head 6cec81c8, review passed in round 2, checks pass; joins batch 16 with o13 #792 and c201 L2 #794, after batch 15 (#793) merges. merge.py now refuses while any workflow runs on another ready PR; with no branch protection, every pending check counts. Its outbox note was not written (the proxy refused its roadmap push), so this is recorded from the coordinator's message. Merged Oct 28 22:45 CDT: #795 closed as replaced by batch 17 #796 (main 134b23ca). Done.
